title: Keep The Ammo Flowing Trailer. My mobile turret defense game.
author: yapdakilla81
selftext:
Mine. Forge. Fight. Keep the ammo flowing.



Survive relentless creature swarms in Keep the Ammo Flowing, a top-down action game where keeping your guns supplied is part of the fight.



Mine ore, forge ammunition, lay tracks, and upgrade your rig as you push through hostile underground sectors. Switch between travel and siege modes, experiment with special ammunition, and hold the line.



🔥 Wishlist on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5158540/Keep\_The\_Ammo\_Flowing/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5158540/Keep_The_Ammo_Flowing/)
